name: FanXin 3x3 UFO Cube
description: Take your puzzling skills out of this world! The FanXin 3x3 UFO Cube is a creative shape mod designed in the iconic profile of an Unidentified Flying Object. This is not your ordinary 3x3—the unique, disc-inspired design offers a fun twist on the classic cube, making each solve feel novel and intriguing.
features: Striking UFO shape for an eye-catching solve
Stable, cross-foot structure to prevent pops
Large rounded corners deliver excellent fault tolerance and a smooth turning experience
